claims.text:
The meaning of the name Saradas is unknown. J.R.R. Tolkien noted that the names of the Bucklanders had a vaguely Celtic style.
Jim Allan suggests that the name Saradas is a variation of the name Saradoc with an -as ending like in Marmadas and Merimas.

claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix F, "On Translation", p. 1135

claims.text: Saradas was the third child and second son of Gorbadoc Brandybuck, and had one son, Seredic. He was present at Bilbo's Farewell Party.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix C, "Brandybuck of Buckland"
